review_text_raw:
It's a "short" PnC adventure. It's fun and interesting until you get stuck trying to figure out what the right evidence combinations are supposed to be because it's not clear what really counts as evidence. It also doesn't support expected keyboard features, like copy/paste and highlighting, so it's tedious to type out IP addresses and there's too many opportunities to screw it up. 

I personally had fun playing this, but would I really recommend this for someone else? Not really.
